company.shortDescription: Khoj is the open-source, AI second brain. Get answers from your notes, documents, and the internet.
company.description: Khoj is an AI answer engine. It can take your questions and track down answers from your notes, PDFs, and the public internet. We allow you to use any foundation model, across the suite of state of the art offerings, to get the most accurate answers to your questions.

productsAndServices.description: An interface enabling users to ask complex questions across documents and the internet, with support for voice interaction and visual content generation.
